POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning General workshop rules and regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.

2. When learning General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   B. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

4. When learning Vehicle body, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body.

5. When learning Blending of lines and curves, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending of lines and curves.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Blending of lines and curves.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending of lines and curves.

6. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.

7. When learning Road wheels, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

9. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

10. When learning Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.

11. When learning Evolution of motor vehicles, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution of motor vehicles.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Motor Vehicle Chassis and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Vehicle body joining processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to engines 4.2 Types of Engines 4.3 Classifications of Engine 4.4 E and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Engines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.

2. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

3. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

4. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.

8. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

10. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.

11. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution of motor vehicles.

12. B — CPU

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Motor Vehicle Chassis; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Vehicle body joining processes; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to engines 4.2 Types of Engines 4.3 Classifications of Engine 4.4 E; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to Engines; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
